title: Bot perception snapshot
description: What one bot perceives: everything a user could possibly see in the 3.3.5a client (plus that bot's addons), split by visibility: glance (on screen without acting), open (inside a panel the bot opened), hover (in a tooltip it points at). Explained in snapshot.md. Types inherit with allOf; fields carry x-visibility.

Relative.description: Where something is relative to the bot.

behind_it.description: bot is behind it (Backstab, frontal cones)

Tooltip.description: The client's tooltip lines, in order.

Ability.description: A spell/item on the bot's action bars.

Activity.description: What a unit is doing (NPCs, allies, bosses, enemies alike).

with.description: whom it fights, follows or talks to

threat_status.description: default UI threat indicator vs me

pack.description: Mobs standing together (pulling one likely pulls the pack), as a player sees them grouped

visual_state.description: What its model visibly shows without targeting it (sheep, stun stars, ice block, sleeping, banished, fleeing in fear...)

quest_relevant.description: Questie nameplate/quest icon: the quest it counts for (with Questie)

Self.description: The bot itself: a Player plus what only its own UI shows.

indicators.description: Main-screen cues: flashing buttons, badges, the damaged-armor figure.

durability_warning.description: the armor figure: damaged (yellow) / broken (red) slots

bag_free_slots.description: free bag space shown on the backpack

gcd_remaining_ms.description: global cooldown sweep on the action bars

auto_attack.description: auto attack / auto shot / wand (button flashing)

in_cinematic.description: watching a cutscene or scripted sequence (can't act)

starts_quest.description: 'This Item Begins a Quest' (loot window/bag icon)

item_button.description: usable quest item button in the tracker (native since 3.3)

ui.description: Which panels are open and what the bot hovers (set by open/close/hover commands and auto-open rules).

tooltips.description: Tooltips of what the bot is hovering.

surroundings.description: When stuck, a path failed, or in tight terrain: what a human would see in 3D, from navmesh/vmaps.

image.description: optional synthetic top-down render (base64 PNG) for a vision model

tracked.description: blips from active tracking (Find Herbs, Track Beasts...)

quest_tracker.description: Watched quests (on screen) plus the bot's own goals (its to-do list, always in mind).

action_bars.description: Buttons on screen: cooldown sweeps, usable/out-of-range coloring, charges. Tooltips on hover.

instance_map.description: inside an instance: the dungeon map (floors, areas, bosses)

map.description: World map (open panel): places, bordering zones, objective areas, Questie pins; zone level ranges on hover.

bags.description: Open bags (auto-opens with merchant, bank, mail, trade).

quest_log.description: All quests with text (the tracker shows only watched ones).

questie.description: Questie tooltip line, e.g. 'Sting of the Scorpid: 4/10' (with Questie)
